description_en: Query log backup files for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 MongoDB 版实例的日志备份文件
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-binlog-files --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id dds-wz9ca592fc637a54 --start-time 2021-03-23T06:24:21.425Z --end-time 2023-04-17T05:50:28.914Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBinlogFiles

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. If the instance is a sharded cluster, you must also specify the NodeId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 实例id。当本参数传入的是分片集群实例id时，还需要传入nodeid参数
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the mongos node or shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

This parameter is applicable only to sharded cluster instances
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID或Shard节点ID。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.xxxZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The time must be later than the start time. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.xxxZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.xxxZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region of the source instance for a cross-region backup.

This parameter is required when you query cross-region backups
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份源实例所在区域。

当查询的是异地备份时，需要且必填
parameters.name: src_region

parameters.help_en:
The region where the cross-region backup is stored.

This parameter is required when you query cross-region backups
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份所在地域。

查询异地备份时，该参数必填
parameters.name: dest_region

parameters.help_en: The binlog ID. This parameter is not currently supported
parameters.name: binlog_id

LogFile.description_en: The details of the binlog files

items.description_en: The details of a binlog file

BinLogId.description_zh: Binlog 日志 ID（暂未支持）

DownloadLink.description_en: The download link for the binlog file

DumpBucket.description_en: The storage location of the binlog file. (Currently not supported.)
DumpBucket.description_zh: binlog文件存储位置。（暂未支持）

DumpDownloadURL.description_en: The OSS download link for the binlog file. (Currently not supported.)
DumpDownloadURL.description_zh: binlog文件oss下载链接。（暂未支持）

FileId.description_en: The unique identifier for the binlog file

FileSize.description_en: The size of the binlog file, in bytes

LinkExpiredTime.description_en: The URL expiration time. (Currently not supported.)

LogBeginTime.description_en:
The start time of the data in the binlog file.

Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
LogBeginTime.description_zh: 日志文件记录的开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

LogEndTime.description_en: The end time of the data in the binlog file. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)

LogFileName.description_en: The name of the binlog file

LogStatus.description_en:
The log backup status.

Valid values:

Uploading: The file is being uploaded.

Completed: The file has been successfully uploaded
LogStatus.description_zh:
日志备份状态。

返回值：

Uploading：上传中
Completed：上传完成

OSSEndpoint.description_en: The OSS endpoint where the binlog file is stored. (Currently not supported.)

MaxRecordsPerPage.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned results

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of binlog files found
